h:
这种以 SDXL 为重点的 Image2Image 流程利用您所需的 SDXL 基本模型和 SDXL Refiner。为了简化该过程，所有步骤都会自动完成，您所要做的就是更改降噪强度。

请阅读流程中集成的注释。

关于此版本（V1.2）

  • 整理了一些逻辑节点

  • 将缩放节点替换为“并排缩放”节点，以实现更轻松的自动化

  • 更改了 FaceDetailer 节点上的默认设置

o.en:
This SDXL focused Image2Image process utilizes your desired SDXL base model with the SDXL Refiner. To ease the process, all steps are automatically taken care of, all you have to do is change the denoising strength.

Please read the notes integrated in the flow.

About this version (V1.2)

  • Tidied up some logic nodes

  • Swapped the scale node with a "scale by side" node for easier automation

  • Changed default settings on FaceDetailer node
